The '''bobwhite''' is an unfinished chicken variant in [[Matcha Flavoured]]. The 1.12.3 release contains only leftovers of it: three debug spawn eggs in loot tables, the resource pack's spawn egg model and sounds, and names for them. There is no way to meet a bobwhite in a normal world.

== Obtaining ==
Three loot tables in the datapack's <code>debug/chicken</code> folder each give a chicken spawn egg with the bobwhite's spawn egg model and a custom name, for use with <code>/loot give</code> only. No chest, mob or trade uses them.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/loot_table/debug/chicken/normal_bobwhite.json}}</ref>
{| class="wikitable"
! Egg !! Loot table !! Spawns
|-
| {{ItemLink|Normal Bobwhite}} || <code>matcha:debug/chicken/normal_bobwhite</code> || An adult chicken tagged <code>wild</code> at 0.8 times the normal size
|-
| {{ItemLink|Mama Bobwhite}} || <code>matcha:debug/chicken/mama_bobwhite</code> || An adult chicken tagged <code>mama</code>
|-
| {{ItemLink|Baby Bobwhite}} || <code>matcha:debug/chicken/baby_bobwhite</code> || A chick tagged <code>wild</code> whose age is locked, so it never grows up
|}
Each egg asks for the chicken variant <code>matcha:bobwhite</code> and the sound variant <code>matcha:bobwhite</code>.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/loot_table/debug/chicken/baby_bobwhite.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/loot_table/debug/chicken/mama_bobwhite.json}}</ref> The release has no definition for either variant, because the files that defined the chicken variants were removed before it, so the eggs cannot make a bobwhite.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/loot_table/debug/chicken/normal_bobwhite.json}}</ref>

== Resource pack ==
The resource pack still has the bobwhite's sound events (ambient with four calls, and hurt), whose subtitles read "Bobwhite Sings" and "Bobwhite Cries", and a name for an item called "Small Egg" (<code>item.kleispack.bobwhite_egg</code>).<ref>{{Source|MF_resourcepack/assets/matcha/sounds.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_resourcepack/assets/minecraft/lang/en_us.json}}</ref> No datapack file gives that egg. The language file also names duck and seagull subtitles and green and teal eggs, in the same unfinished set.
